Department

The Powertrain Manufacturing Engineering (PTME) Europe team is at the forefront of innovation, dedicated to equipping our manufacturing plants with world-leading systems. We are committed to modernising our business by designing and installing advanced manufacturing solutions that enable our plants to efficiently deliver our diverse portfolio of propulsion systems and cutting-edge battery solutions for vehicles.

As manufacturing becomes increasingly connected and data-driven, PTME plays a critical role in combining engineering expertise, advanced analytics and digital technologies to improve quality, productivity, equipment performance and operational excellence across our manufacturing network.

To support this mission, we are a travelling department with regular opportunities to work alongside manufacturing plants and suppliers across Ford's global operations.

Opportunity

As a key member of our PTME team, you will play a crucial role in shaping the future of automotive manufacturing through machine learning, advanced analytics and data-driven decision making.

You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, developing analytical solutions and delivering measurable business outcomes across the full project lifecycle. This role offers the unique opportunity to combine technical data science expertise with real-world manufacturing problem solving.

You will apply machine learning, statistical modelling and advanced analytics techniques to unlock insights from connected manufacturing data while working alongside a collaborative team of engineers, manufacturing specialists and business stakeholders.

PTME is looking for an individual who can help expand the use of data science throughout the organisation. You will collaborate with a team of over 100 manufacturing engineers and must be comfortable working directly with stakeholders both in our Dunton office and at manufacturing facilities.

This is not a traditional analytics role focused solely on model development. Successful candidates will be expected to take ownership from problem definition through data acquisition, solution development, deployment support and business adoption.

Hybrid Worker (minimum 4 days on-site per week)

Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required

Your role will:

Develop and Maintain:
Build machine learning, statistical and forecasting models to optimise manufacturing processes and extract actionable intelligence from equipment, process and operational data.

Design and Build:
Create and manage scalable data pipelines using Python and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ingest, transform and prepare complex manufacturing data for analysis and deployment.

Interface and Translate:
Work directly with internal and external stakeholders to translate manufacturing and business challenges into structured analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions.

Facilitate:
Act as a strong facilitator to gather requirements, manage stakeholder expectations, validate analytical outputs and support organisational adoption of analytical solutions.

Standardise:
Perform data reconciliation, cleansing and standardisation across diverse manufacturing systems to ensure high data quality, consistency and analytical integrity.

Support Launches:
Provide technical assistance and data-driven insight during the launch of new manufacturing processes, equipment and programmes.

Communicate:
Present analytical findings and actionable recommendations clearly, adapting communication styles for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaborate:
Work closely with innovation, software, data engineering and enterprise data teams to ensure analytical solutions are scalable, deployable and aligned with broader technology strategies.

Mentor and Document:
Teach, coach and mentor peers while documenting technical knowledge, analytical approaches and best practices to support long-term capability growth.

Drive Continuous Improvement:
Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, technical excellence and data-driven decision making.

On-Site Execution:
Travel to Ford manufacturing plants and supplier locations globally, as required by project and programme needs, to understand operational challenges, support implementations and collaborate directly with on-site teams.

Experience and skills for being effective in the role are:

Technical Proficiency:
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, machine learning and statistical modelling (e.g. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), alongside familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, preferably Google Cloud.

Analytical Modelling:
Proven experience developing analytical, statistical or machine learning solutions within complex operational environments, coupled with a strong desire to continuously improve model performance, data quality and business outcomes.

Project Execution:
Demonstrated ability to lead analytical projects from problem definition through development, deployment and business adoption.

Communication & Stakeholder Management:
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence decision making and work effectively in complex environments.

Data Engineering:
Hands-on experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and analytical data products using structured data engineering practices.

Problem Solving:
Ability to translate complex business problems into structured analytical frameworks, supported by a passion for uncovering insights and solving challenging real-world manufacturing problems.

Manufacturing Acumen & Domain Knowledge (Preferred):
Direct experience working with manufacturing, industrial, IoT, connected equipment or Industry 4.0 data environments. Experience within automotive, battery, propulsion systems or other advanced manufacturing sectors would be advantageous.

Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related quantitative discipline.

If you do not hold a degree but possess relevant skills and experience equivalent to this level of education, we would still welcome your application.

City: London

Division: Corporate - CFO

Why work for us?

A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing in a brighter future together.

Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. We will do this by protecting and growing our core business, amplifying our strengths and diversifying where we have the right.

Our Values are key to driving our success, and are at the heart of everything we do:

Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!

Your opportunity

This is a business-facing engineering role. You will sit with business users, work out what is slowing them down, and turn those problems into AI and data solutions that reach production. The work starts with a conversation at someone’s desk, not a ticket in a queue.

Janus Henderson is undertaking a firm-wide AI transformation to become the most technologically sophisticated asset manager in the industry. Our AI capability sits in a single centralised function under the Head of AI, and Forward Deployed Engineering is the part of it that embeds with the business and builds what business units cannot stand up alone. You will work alongside the AI Enablement Partners, who surface and triage demand: where they establish what a team needs, you build it. Reporting to the Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you own your solutions from first conversation to live running.

The work spans the full stack — sourcing internal and external data, curating it into views that answer the questions a desk actually asks, and making it reusable through Accio, our centralised MCP server. The most advanced work is investment engineering: building quantitative capability on Nexus, our agentic workspace, and taking it from one desk to a firm-wide offering such as relative-value signal generation. Your toolkit spans Python and SQL, LLMs and agent frameworks, MCP, Azure AI Foundry through the AI Team’s model gateway, Snowflake, and Azure with Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD.

What success looks like

You ship. What you build reaches production, is used by the business unit you built it for, and stays healthy once live.

Business users come to you early enough that you shape the problem rather than receive finished requirements.

Capability proven on one desk is exposed through Accio and Nexus so other teams consume it rather than rebuild it.
You need less direction over time, taking on engagements that are less defined and more technically demanding.

Your responsibilities

Embed with the business

Sit with business users — portfolio managers, analysts, traders, marketing, sales, HR, and operations — to understand their workflows, their data, and their day-to-day friction.

Partner with the AI Enablement Partners on escalated demand that business teams and citizen developers cannot deliver themselves.

Set realistic expectations on what is feasible, what it will take, and what it will not do.

Deliver solutions end to end

Design, build, and productionise bespoke, higher-complexity AI solutions, owning them through to live running.

Prototype with the business close at hand, then harden what works into production rather than leaving a demonstration.

Own the architecture and design decisions for your solutions, keeping them secure, scalable, and aligned to the enterprise core stack.

Take solutions through evaluation, observability, and our AI governance checkpoints, and keep them healthy afterwards.

Build investment capability on Nexus

Build advanced investment capability on Nexus and make it available across the firm.

Work with quantitative researchers and investment teams to take models and signals from one desk into a supported, firm-wide capability.

Put validation, monitoring, and reproducibility around signal output investment professionals rely on, and help take citizen developer workflows through to production.

Make data and capability reusable

Source data through APIs, vendor feeds, and enterprise systems, and build the ingestion pipelines that keep it flowing.

Curate raw data into business-focused views, and own its lineage, quality, and freshness.

Expose data and capability through Accio, and as skills, tools, and connectors on Nexus, so any approved agent or application can reach them.

Build reusable components rather than one-off integrations, and feed the patterns back to AI Architecture and AI Engineering.

Work across the AI function

Co-build enterprise core-stack deliverables with Percepta and AI Engineering, designed for transfer into business-as-usual.

Work with AI Security and AI Governance Implementation so solutions meet our security, data-privacy, and responsible-AI standards.

Keep current with LLM capabilities, agent patterns, and AI tooling, and bring back what is genuinely useful.

What to expect when you join our firm

Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations

Generous Holiday policies

Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to Wellhub

Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community

Support to grow through professional development courses, tuition/qualification reimbursement and more

Maternal/paternal leave benefits and family services

All employee events including networking opportunities and social activities

Lunch allowance for use within our subsidized onsite canteen

Must have skills

At minimum four years in a technical, business-facing engineering role — forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, consulting-side software engineering, or engineering embedded in a business unit. Former technical founders are encouraged to apply.

Strong Python and SQL, and a track record of shipping production applications rather than prototypes.

Production experience with LLMs, covering prompt and context engineering, agent development, evaluation, and deployment at scale.

Hands-on experience building agentic capability — MCP servers, tools, skills, or connectors — for other systems and agents to consume.

Experience building data pipelines from APIs and enterprise systems, and modelling raw data into curated, business-facing views.

Working knowledge of a major cloud, ideally Azure, with CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure as code.

Excellent stakeholder skills. You can run discovery with a portfolio manager in the morning and write the pipeline in the afternoon.

High agency and comfort with ambiguity, and genuine interest in the business problem rather than only the technology.

Experience in a regulated environment where governance, compliance, and data sensitivity shape how solutions are built.

Nice to have skills

Asset management or financial services domain knowledge, particularly the investment process, front office workflows, or fixed income.

Quantitative investment concepts such as fair value, relative value, signal generation, or portfolio construction.

Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake, or comparable enterprise data platforms.

Azure AI Foundry, model gateways, inference routing, or AI evaluation and observability in production.

TypeScript or a second production language, and front-end experience for user-facing AI applications.

Supervisory responsibilities

No. This is an individual-contributor role. Forward Deployed Engineers lead delivery of their own engagements and mentor less experienced engineers, but do not line-manage.

Potential for growth

Mentoring

Leadership development programs

Regular training

Career development services

Continuing education courses

Description:

Department: Growth & Customer Experience Engineering
Reporting to: Technology Manager
Location: Bristol/London
Hybrid role: 3 days a week from office & 2 days working from home
Full time / Part time role: Full time

Ready for a challenge?
Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join a cross functional team, focussing on growing our product algorithmic recommendations within Just Eat Takeaway.com.

Your team will focus on evolving existing machine learning and AI capabilities across the platform, improving those capabilities, and innovating new ones for the future.

As a Senior Engineer you will drive our architecture, write highly scalable and testable code, mentor engineers and challenge our teams to strive for excellence. You will work closely with a large number of teams, both internal and external, with inner-sourced development our standard way of working.
Ownership is one of the core engineering principles in our organisation - we write it and we own it. Engineers are expected to take responsibility for their work from discovery to production, ensuring the ongoing reliability and stability of our systems.

This role offers you the opportunity to lead, deliver, and care for cutting-edge ML systems that impact millions of customers daily.

These are some of the key components to the position:

- Collaborate extensively with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Backend Engineers to bridge the gap between model development and production systems
- Lead the architectural design of end-to-end ML systems, from data ingestion and training pipelines to real-time inference and monitoring infrastructure
- Transform innovative data science prototypes into robust, scalable, and secure production software, taking ownership of the 'path to production'
- Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices (CI/CD for ML, model versioning, feature stores) to accelerate the feedback loop for Data Scientists
- Effectively communicate the complexities of ML systems (e.g., latency vs. accuracy trade-offs) to technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Build and maintain a strong network across the Data and Engineering organizations to ensure ML systems integrate seamlessly with the wider platform
- Lead projects, mentor peers, and advocate for engineering excellence within the data science domain

What will you bring to the team?

- Proficiency in Python and a strong understanding of software engineering principles (OO design, patterns, testing) applied to Machine Learning
- Demonstrable experience designing and operating ML systems in production (not just training models in notebooks), including familiarity with serving patterns (e.g., REST APIs, batch inference, event-driven)
- Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and cloud-native ML platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI)
- Ability to influence decision-making regarding infrastructure and tooling, balancing 'build vs. buy' discussions
- Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
- Familiarity with data engineering fundamentals (SQL, distributed data processing) to debug and optimize data flows
- A proactive mindset to automate manual processes and a passion for improving the developer experience for Data Scientists

At JET, this is how we play
Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging
No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are seeking a talented and experienced Research Engineer to join our newly forming Search and Services Platform team within Research Platform. You will build and operate the large-scale search and services that our models rely on as tools — from self-hosted, web-scale, search indexes to knowledge graphs and databases served through MCP. You will work closely with researchers and with the pretraining data, sandbox and data platform teams to make these services reliable, scalable and fast, on infrastructure measured in hundreds of terabytes of NVMe storage and thousands of CPU cores to support both data generation and critical training runs.

What you will do

As a Research Engineer on the Search and Services team, your responsibilities will include (but may not be limited to):

- Designing, building and operating large-scale search infrastructure: self-hosted Vespa clusters indexing web-scale corpora, managed indexes for smaller corpora, and vendor search endpoints.

- Self-hosting and maintaining a wide range of structured data sources — knowledge graphs (Wikidata, UniProt, Materials Project), scholarly data (OpenAlex, OpenAIRE), statistical databases (Eurostat, World Bank, IMF, OECD), open data portals and more.

- Designing interfaces and tools to expose to the models and agents to use the services in different ways (direct YQL or SPARQL queries, or more refined and constrained MCPs to mimic external services) to support data generation and agentic training.

- Building the data pipelines that ingest, index and serve massive datasets, including indexing our own pretraining corpora for exploration, deduplication and eval-leakage checks.

- Building strong relationships with researchers and adjacent teams (pretraining data,, sandbox, data platform), understanding their workflows and enabling them to achieve more by leveraging your expertise.

- Communicating and producing documentation or any content that will help teams make the most of the services you'll build.

About you

- 5+ years of successful experience in search engineering, data infrastructure, or a similar SRE / platform role.

- Proficiency in software development (Python, Go...) and programming best practices.

- Hands-on experience with large-scale search or data systems (e.g. Vespa, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, ClickHouse or similar).

- Exposure to site reliability engineering: root cause analysis, in-production troubleshooting, on-call rotations...)

- Exposure to infrastructure management: containerization, orchestration (Kubernetes), infra-as-code, monitoring, logging, alerting, observability...).

- Experience designing and operating data pipelines that address large amounts of data.

- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills (ability to contextualizing, gauging risks and getting buy-in for high stakes and impactful solutions).

- Ownership, high agency and constantly seeking to learn and improving things for others.

- Autonomous, self-driven and able to work well in a fast-paced startup environment.

- Low ego and team spirit mindset.

- Your application will be all the more interesting if you also have:

- First-hand Vespa (or equivalent large-scale information retrieval) experience.

- Experience building or operating MCP servers / tool-serving infrastructure for LLMs.

- Familiarity with knowledge graphs, RDF / SPARQL, or large structured databases (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DuckDB...).

- Experience with large bare-metal infrastructure or HPC environments.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

As a Research Engineer on the Orchestral team, you will help build the agentic platform we use to train and evaluate our models. What you build becomes the foundation the whole science team works on.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design and build the core of the Orchestral platform: the library, abstractions and tooling researchers use to train and evaluate models.

- Build and evolve the rollout engine, shipping new capabilities such as long-running tasks and subagents.

- Run Orchestral as a production system: keep training and evaluation workloads reliable at scale.

- Improve how data and jobs flow through the platform as usage grows — scheduling, routing and request handling.

- Treat researchers as your users: understand their workflows and turn recurring needs into robust, shared tooling.

- Raise the bar on engineering quality across the platform: testing, code review, CI/CD, observability and documentation.

- Contribute to open-source rollout-engine and agent-infrastructure projects where it benefits the platform.

- Experience directly building and debugging complex distributed systems at scale, with an emphasis on reliability and scalability.

- Strong Python skills and solid software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

- A builder mindset: you have constructed systems from the ground up, not just operated polished ones.

- A track record in small teams running complex systems at scale — for example in finance, crypto or ad tech.

- Self-starter, low-ego and collaborative, with a product mindset toward your users.

- Curiosity about ML and RL — this experience is not required, but a desire to learn is.

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Hands-on experience with Ray or similar distributed-computing frameworks.

- Open-source contributions, especially to rollout-engine or agent-infrastructure projects such as SLIME, verl or PrimeRL.

- Experience building or working with agentic workflows and environments.

The Role

As an AI Deployment Lead / Applied AI Consultant, you'll work directly with our most strategic customers to understand their objectives and key challenges, identify high-impact AI opportunities, and translate them into measurable business value.

You'll be building AI solutions on Omnea's procurement automation platform, combining the structured data flowing through requests, approvals, contracts, and supplier records with AI. Omnea gives AI the operational context of how a business actually buys, so it can move past answering questions and start taking action inside procurement itself: routing requests, flagging risk, drafting contract terms, negotiating with suppliers. There is no AI without that context.

You'll prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realisation, growing Omnea's footprint at those customers as you go.

This customer-facing role is ideal for people who enjoy working directly with customers and turning complex business challenges into practical AI solutions. The focus is on problem framing, solution design, and business impact rather than pure implementation. While you will prototype AI solutions, the primary goal is to deliver meaningful business value to customers.

What You'll Do

Identify High-Impact AI Opportunities:
Work closely with enterprise customers to understand their strategic priorities and operational challenges, identifying where AI can deliver measurable business value.

Design AI-Powered Solutions:
Translate complex business problems into scalable solution architectures, using Omnea's AI to eliminate manual work across procurement.

Prototype and Demonstrate Value:
Rapidly build prototypes and proof-of-value solutions that demonstrate tangible outcomes to business and technical stakeholders.

Lead AI Innovation with Customers:
Facilitate workshops, hackathons, and innovation sessions with customers to explore new ways AI can transform their operations.

Drive Adoption and Business Impact:
Partner with customer teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, and realisation of measurable value from AI deployments.

Develop Domain Expertise:
Build deep expertise in specific industries or business domains (e.g., supply chain, finance) and help scale that knowledge across the organisation.

What's Different About This Role

You'll spend more time on problem framing and validation than on hand-building every proof of value. AI can generate a working prototype fast; your job is deciding whether it actually solves the customer's problem.

Writing a sharp brief for what you want AI to build is now core to the role, not a side skill.

Judgment on business impact matters more than raw build speed: which use case actually moves the metric the customer cares about, and which is just an impressive demo.

You'll keep pushing on what's possible as Omnea's AI tooling evolves, and bring what you learn back to the rest of the team.

About You

You might be a great fit if you…

have 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, data / AI consulting, technical pre-sales, sales engineering, value engineering, or customer-facing solution-architecture or AI roles

enjoy translating business challenges into technical solutions

can communicate complex technical concepts to business and executive stakeholders

have a good understanding of business processes across procurement, finance, and supply chain, with the ability to translate high-level business needs into specific AI use cases

demonstrate strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos

know how to measure the business impact of what you've delivered, and can turn that into a clear story for stakeholders - time saved, error rates down, adoption up, whatever the metric that actually matters to that customer

have hands-on experience identifying, designing, and building automations or AI-driven solutions for repeatable processes, not just scoping them on paper

Title: ML / LLM Research Engineer

ML / LLM Research Engineer, National Security

£80,000 to £90,000 + 10% bonus for DV clearance

Manchester | Hybrid / Secure Site Working | Permanent

Ncounter is supporting a growing technology consultancy looking for an experienced ML Research Engineer to join a specialist team working across AI, machine learning and secure government programmes. The immediate project is particularly interesting, combining hands-on engineering with genuine research into the security and behaviour of Large Language Models. Rather than simply building applications around existing AI tooling, you will investigate how models work internally, exploring areas such as how information is processed, where data moves, whether it could contribute to future training and whether models present risks when deployed within secure environments. - Active SC clearance as a minimum, with previous high-side experience particularly valuable

- Strong Python development skills, this is a hands-on engineering position and you must be comfortable coding

- Strong underlying knowledge of machine learning and Deep Neural Networks, including an understanding of how models operate internally

Nice to have:

- Research experience, with the ability to understand technical literature and turn findings into practical experiments

- Specific experience with LLMs is highly desirable, particularly research into their architecture, behaviour or security

- A strong mathematical or STEM background, with MSc or PhD-level research particularly attractive

- Exposure to AI/ML security, model safety, explainability or similar areas would be beneficial

- Broader ML engineering skills, allowing you to move between research-led and more traditional engineering projects over time

The position offers more variety than a purely academic research role. Beyond the initial programme, you will contribute across the wider ML engineering lifecycle, including production-quality development, testing, documentation and code reviews.

The role is expected to require around three days per week onsite, potentially more when secure environments require it.

If you combine genuine ML research depth with strong Python engineering skills and want to apply that knowledge to complex, security-focused AI problems, contact Ncounter to discuss the opportunity.
